newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends firm on Colombia export talk, cash.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends firm on Colombia export talk, cash.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed higher on talk that Colombia would soon import rice from the U.S., traders said.
"Colombia is going to be buying rice soon. The Ag Attache says they need 200,000 tonnes of rice," a trader said.
News that the Colombian Agriculture Ministry approved the import of 140,000 tonnes of rough rice came after the close of futures trading.
It was not clear which country would sell the rice to Colombia.
Rice futures volume was estimated by the CBOT at 1,200 contracts, above the 1,094 traded Tuesday.
Rice futures closed two to 16-1/2 cents per cwt higher, with March up 15 at $12.14 per cwt.
